title: Northern Region Cement reports 48% year-on-year increase in nine-month profit
summary: Northern Region Cement reports 48% year-on-year increase in nine-month profit
body_markdown: **Saudi Arabia:** For the nine-month period ending on 30 September 2026, Northern Region Cement announced a net profit of US$6.3m, up by 48% year-on-year compared to US$4.3m during the same period in 2025. The company reported sales which totalled US$73m, up by 55% year-on-year compared to US$47m recorded in the corresponding period of 2025. The increase in sales during the 2026 quarter compared to the same quarter in 2025 was attributed to higher sales volumes following the start of operations at the company’s overseas investments.
